tests.command: bash -c 'for d in frontend backend e2e security ops .github/workflows; do test -d "$d" || exit 1; done && git ls-files --error-unmatch e2e/.gitkeep security/.gitkeep ops/.gitkeep .github/workflows/.gitkeep >/dev/null'

bash -c 'test -f backend/app/__init__.py && for d in models schemas routers services auth audit core scripts; do test -f "backend/app/$d/__init__.py" || exit 1; done && test -f backend/tests/__init__.py && test -f backend/tests/unit/__init__.py && test -f backend/tests/integration/__init__.py && test -f backend/alembic/versions/.gitkeep'

bash -c 'for d in api components/ui components/layout components/charts components/forms components/common pages hooks context types utils test; do test -f "frontend/src/$d/.gitkeep" || exit 1; done && test -f frontend/public/.gitkeep'
bash -c 'for p in probe.db probe.sqlite3 probe.log RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK build/x coverage/x; do git check-ignore -q "$p" || exit 1; done'
bash -c 'test -z "$(git ls-files -- .env "*.db" "*.sqlite3" "*RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK*")"'
bash -c 'test -d frontend && test -z "$(find e2e security ops .github -type f ! -name .gitkeep ! -name __init__.py 2>/dev/null)"'

bash -c 'cd backend && test -f pyproject.toml && grep -Eq "requires-python *= *\"[^\"]*3\.12" pyproject.toml && for p in fastapi uvicorn sqlalchemy alembic pydantic python-jose passlib httpx pytest-cov pytest-asyncio pytest ruff mypy; do grep -qi -- "$p" pyproject.toml || exit 1; done && test -f uv.lock'
bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv sync >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && test -f app/main.py && grep -Eq "def create_app" app/main.py && grep -Eq "^app *= *create_app" app/main.py && uv run pytest tests/unit/test_smoke.py -q >/dev/null 2>&1'
bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && out=$(uv run pytest -q 2>&1) || exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -Eq "[1-9][0-9]* passed"'
bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd backend && uv run ruff check . >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run mypy . >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"./frontend/package.json\",\"utf8\"));const d=Object.assign({},p.dependencies,p.devDependencies);const r=[\"react\",\"react-dom\",\"react-router-dom\",\"@tanstack/react-query\",\"axios\",\"tailwindcss\",\"vitest\",\"@testing-library/react\",\"msw\",\"eslint\",\"prettier\",\"typescript\"];const b=r.filter(k=>!d[k]||!/^[0-9]/.test(d[k]));if(b.length){console.error(\"unpinned or missing: \"+b.join(\", \"));process.exit(1)}" && git ls-files --error-unmatch frontend/package-lock.json >/dev/null'
bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npm install --no-audit --no-fund" >/dev/null'

bash -c 'test -f frontend/src/main.tsx && grep -q createRoot frontend/src/main.tsx && grep -q "id=\"root\"" frontend/index.html && ls frontend/tailwind.config.* >/dev/null && grep -RqE "@tailwind (base|components|utilities)" frontend/src --include=*.css && grep -RqE "className=\"[^\"]*(flex|grid|min-h-screen|mx-auto|p-[0-9]|text-[a-z])" frontend/src --include=*.tsx'
bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && find frontend/src -name "*.test.tsx" | grep -q . && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npm test -- --run" >/dev/null'
bash -c 'test -f frontend/tsconfig.json && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npx tsc --noEmit"'

bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"./frontend/package.json\",\"utf8\"));const d=Object.assign({},p.dependencies,p.devDependencies);const bad=Object.keys(d).filter(k=>/^(styled-components|@emotion\/|styled-jsx|@stitches\/|@linaria\/|react-native-css)/.test(k)||/^(react-hook-form|zod|recharts|date-fns)$/.test(k));if(bad.length){console.error(\"forbidden or deferred dependency: \"+bad.join(\", \"));process.exit(1)}"'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv run pytest tests/integration/test_health_api.py::TestHealthApi::test_health_returns_200_without_auth tests/integration/test_health_api.py::TestHealthApi::test_health_body_has_exactly_four_fields -q >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv run pytest tests/integration/test_health_api.py::TestHealthApi::test_health_response_matches_pydantic_schema -q >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv run pytest tests/integration/test_health_api.py::TestHealthApi::test_health_phase1_reports_ok_no_fallback -q >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && test -f tests/integration/test_health_api.py && out=$(uv run pytest -q 2>&1) || exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -Eq "[1-9][0-9]* passed"'
bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd backend && uv run ruff check . >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run mypy . >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'test -f .env.example && git ls-files --error-unmatch .env.example >/dev/null && for v in DATABASE_URL JWT_SECRET JWT_ALGORITHM JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES JWT_ISSUER JWT_AUDIENCE CORS_ORIGINS ENVIRONMENT APP_VERSION DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT VITE_API_BASE_URL MCP_API_BASE_URL MCP_JWT_SECRET PLATFORM API_TOKEN REPO_ID; do grep -Eq "^$v=" .env.example || exit 1; done && ! grep -Eqi "(secret|token|password)[a-z_]*=[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9+/]{24,}" .env.example && ! grep -Eq "(ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}|glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16})" .env.example && test -z "$(git ls-files -- .env)"'

bash -c 'command -v make >/dev/null || exit 1; test -f Makefile && git ls-files --error-unmatch Makefile >/dev/null && for t in setup setup-backend setup-frontend dev dev-backend dev-frontend test test-backend test-frontend lint lint-backend lint-frontend down migrate seed e2e security; do grep -Eq "^${t}[[:space:]]*:" Makefile || exit 1; make -n "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; done && for r in "uv sync" "uv run pytest" "uv run ruff" "uv run mypy" "npm install" "npm test"; do grep -qP "^\t.*($r)" Makefile || exit 1; done && grep -qP "^\t.*(npm run lint|npx tsc --noEmit)" Makefile'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v make >/dev/null || exit 1; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; out=$(make test-backend 2>&1) || exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -Eq "[1-9][0-9]* passed" || exit 1; make lint-backend >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v make >/dev/null || exit 1; out=$(make test-frontend 2>&1) || exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -Eq "vitest|Test Files" || exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -Eq "[1-9][0-9]* passed" || exit 1; make lint-frontend >/dev/null 2>&1'
bash -c 'test -f LICENSE && git ls-files --error-unmatch LICENSE >/dev/null && grep -q "MIT License" LICENSE && grep -q "Permission is hereby granted, free of charge" LICENSE'

bash -c 'test -f README.md && l=$(wc -l < README.md) && [ "$l" -ge 30 ] && [ "$l" -le 500 ] && grep -Eqi "^#{1,6}[[:space:]].*quick start" README.md && grep -Eqi "^#{1,6}[[:space:]].*running tests" README.md && grep -q "cp .env.example .env" README.md && grep -q "make setup" README.md && grep -q "make dev-backend" README.md && grep -q "make dev-frontend" README.md && grep -q "make test" README.md && grep -q "make lint" README.md && grep -Eqi "prerequisite" README.md && grep -Ewq MIT README.md'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv run pytest tests/unit/test_config.py::TestSettings::test_env_var_overrides_default tests/unit/test_config.py::TestSettings::test_defaults_match_env_example -q >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && env JWT_SECRET=change-me ENVIRONMENT=development uv run pytest tests/unit/test_config.py::TestSettings::test_production_rejects_default_secret tests/unit/test_config.py::TestSettings::test_development_allows_default_secret -q >/dev/null 2>&1'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && DATABASE_URL="sqlite:////tmp/t5_ac3.db" uv run pytest tests/integration/test_database.py::TestDatabase::test_get_db_yields_and_closes_session tests/integration/test_database.py::TestDatabase::test_sqlite_pragma_foreign_keys_enabled -q >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; rm -f /tmp/t5_ac3.db; exit $rc'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && test -f alembic.ini && test -f alembic/env.py && rm -f /tmp/t5_ac4.db && DATABASE_URL="sqlite:////tmp/t5_ac4.db" uv run alembic upgrade head >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; test -f /tmp/t5_ac4.db; rc=$?; rm -f /tmp/t5_ac4.db; exit $rc'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v make >/dev/null || exit 1; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; grep -Eq "^migrate[[:space:]]*:" Makefile || exit 1; grep -qP "^\t.*(uv run alembic upgrade head)" Makefile || exit 1; make -n migrate >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; rm -f build/t5_ac5.db; DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///$(pwd)/build/t5_ac5.db" make migrate >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; test -f build/t5_ac5.db; rc=$?; rm -f build/t5_ac5.db; exit $rc'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && DATABASE_URL="sqlite:////tmp/t6_ac1.db" uv run pytest "tests/unit/test_user_model.py::TestUserModel::test_creates_user_with_python_uuid_default_and_typed_columns" -q >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; rm -f /tmp/t6_ac1.db; exit $rc'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && rev=$(ls alembic/versions/001_*.py 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); test -n "$rev" || exit 1; grep -Eq "^revision(: str)? = .001" "$rev" || exit 1; grep -Eq "^down_revision.*= None" "$rev" || exit 1; test "$(uv run alembic heads 2>/dev/null | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 1; rm -f /tmp/t6_ac2.db; export DATABASE_URL="sqlite:////tmp/t6_ac2.db"; uv run alembic upgrade head >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; uv run python -c "import sqlite3; con = sqlite3.connect(\"/tmp/t6_ac2.db\"); cols = {r[1] for r in con.execute(\"pragma table_info(users)\")}; tables = {r[0] for r in con.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type = \\\"table\\\"\")}; assert tables == {\"users\", \"alembic_version\"}, tables; assert cols == {\"id\",\"email\",\"username\",\"hashed_password\",\"is_active\",\"created_at\",\"updated_at\"}, cols; assert con.execute(\"select count(*) from alembic_version\").fetchone()[0] >= 1" || exit 1; uv run python -c "import sqlite3, uuid; con = sqlite3.connect(\"/tmp/t6_ac2.db\"); con.execute(\"insert into users (id, email, username, hashed_password) values (?, ?, ?, ?)\", (str(uuid.uuid4()), \"raw@b.co\", \"rawuser\", \"x\" * 60)); row = con.execute(\"select is_active, created_at, updated_at from users where username = \\\"rawuser\\\"\").fetchone(); assert row[0] in (1, True), row; assert row[1] is not None and row[2] is not None, row" || exit 1; uv run alembic downgrade base >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; uv run python -c "import sqlite3; con = sqlite3.connect(\"/tmp/t6_ac2.db\"); tables = {r[0] for r in con.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type = \\\"table\\\"\")}; assert \"users\" not in tables, tables" || exit 1; uv run alembic upgrade head >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; uv run python -c "import sqlite3; con = sqlite3.connect(\"/tmp/t6_ac2.db\"); cols = {r[1] for r in con.execute(\"pragma table_info(users)\")}; assert cols == {\"id\",\"email\",\"username\",\"hashed_password\",\"is_active\",\"created_at\",\"updated_at\"}, cols"; rc=$?; rm -f /tmp/t6_ac2.db; exit $rc'

bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv run pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run ruff check . >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run mypy . >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*\"bcrypt[>=<]" pyproject.toml && uv run python -c "import tomllib; d = tomllib.load(open(\"uv.lock\", \"rb\")); v = [p[\"version\"] for p in d[\"package\"] if p[\"name\"] == \"bcrypt\"][0]; parts = tuple(int(x) for x in v.split(\".\")[:2]); raise SystemExit(0 if (4, 0) <= parts < (4, 1) else 1)"'
